purpose: Test whether strict Research V2 fundamental coverage can expand without weakening identity, availability, basis, or direct-disclosure rules.

sample.population: NSE exact-ISIN securities that are current-product Baseline eligible and not already Research V2 eligible

identity_rule: Exact current NSE-master ISIN must occur in extracted issuer report text; ticker-only or fuzzy-name matching is insufficient.
availability_rule: Use the official exchange dissemination timestamp and reject reports disseminated after the ranking-date cutoff.
basis_rule: Accept only reviewed audited standalone disclosures for all required fields; never mix standalone and consolidated facts.
discovery_sources: official NSE annual-report API and archive PDF
candidate_rule: Automated PDF extraction creates review candidates only and never model inputs.
prohibited_actions: change Research V2 formulas or weights
derive a ratio from raw accounting facts
start a monthly or multi-year backtest
